_note: Verified 2026-07-12 against Whering's live site (whering.co, /about, /careers), Companies House 12660509, and funding press (tech.eu, theindustry.fashion). The round is a $7m (about GBP5.2m) seed led by eBay Ventures and Google's AI Futures Fund. Public facts only; no contact data.
one_liner: Whering is a digital wardrobe app that lets people catalogue the clothes they already own, plan and style outfits from them, and shop more intentionally.
headcount_source: About page states a team of over 20 people, based in Farringdon, London (whering.co/about, verified 2026-07-12). Bucketed as 11-25.

founders.name: Bianca Rangecroft
founders.background: Founder and CEO of Whering and a director since its incorporation on 10 June 2020; started the company to solve her own wardrobe-management problem and has led it to 10m users.
